_gptSizeRule: Arbitrary WIDTHxHEIGHT is gpt-image-2 only; both edges divisible by 16, aspect between 1:3 and 3:1, fitting inside 3840x2160. gpt-image-1 and 1.5 accept ONLY the three standard sizes, so every resolution collapses to the nearest standard one.
_fluxSizeRule: fal-ai/flux-2 takes image_size as {width,height} with BOTH edges clamped to 512-2048. It does NOT accept aspect_ratio. The 2048 ceiling means only 1:1 can actually reach 4MP; 16:9 tops out at 2.36MP. Retail is a flat price per tier (see fluxTierUsd), so the 4MP tier is WITHHELD at every non-square ratio rather than sold at a size the endpoint cannot produce - resolutionExclusions on the flux family, enforced in request-validation. The dimension table lives in the catalog (model-families FLUX_DIMS) because the request builder reads it; duplicating it here would let the offer and the request drift.
_fluxProviderRate: fal quotes $0.012 per megapixel on the flux-2 model page (documentation only, never seen on an invoice). Retail does NOT track it; the flat tiers below are the deliberate price.
_seedreamSizeRule: image_size accepts auto, auto_2K, auto_4K and the preset enums, or {width,height}; total pixels between 960x960 and 4096x4096. No aspect_ratio parameter, so a non-square ratio must be sent as explicit dimensions.
